info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Textile Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of textile produce details within the catalog system. It allows businesses to efficiently submit new product information, ensuring that the catalog remains current and comprehensive. Typical consumers include inventory managers and product developers who need to add or update details about textile products. The API supports operations that streamline the cataloging process, enhancing product visibility and accessibility for stakeholders.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create details related to textile production. It processes the provided data and stores it for future reference, ensuring that textile produce records are accurately maintained.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for textile production. It should include all required fields as defined in the schema, representing the necessary information for processing the textile produce operations.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested textile produce details.

CreateCatalogTextileProduceDetailRequest.title: Textile Produce Request Body

textile_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the textile produce.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person or entity requesting the textile produce.

quantity.description: The amount of textile produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the textile produce.

CreateCatalogTextileProduceDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a textile produce order.

CreateCatalogTextileProduceDetailRespons.title: Textile Produce Details Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record created or modified.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing occurred.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

CreateCatalogTextileProduceDetailRespons.description: Response schema for the successful operation of producing textile details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource. Commonly used values include 'application/json' or 'text/html'.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
